title: Greenpro Capital Corp. Form 8-K — Departure of Director
summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 disclosing the resignation of Christopher Yu Nien Wong from its Board of Directors, effective April 30, 2026, along with his departure from the Audit, Compensation, and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees. The filing states the resignation was not the result of any disagreement with the company. The company is evaluating candidates to fill the vacancy.
key_points: Christopher Yu Nien Wong resigned from the Board of Directors effective April 30, 2026
Wong also resigned from the Audit Committee, Compensation Committee, and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee
The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company on operations, policies, or practices
Company is evaluating candidates to fill the resulting board vacancy
Filing signed by CEO Lee Chong Kuang on April 24, 2026
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance disclosure for a small-cap NASDAQ-listed company (GRNQ). Board member changes at micro-cap companies typically do not have market-wide implications and are not relevant to macro catalysts or market structure analysis.
